description: This file defines dependency functions for FastAPI endpoints related to user authentication and authorization, specifically fetching the current user and requiring admin privileges.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_current_user(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Dependency function to retrieve the current authenticated user using JWT.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] require_admin(user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Dependency function to verify that the current user has admin privileges.

ctags.name: _auth_get_current_user
ctags.pattern: /^from src.api.auth import get_current_user as _auth_get_current_user, require_admin as _auth_requ/

ctags.name: _auth_require_admin
ctags.pattern: /^from src.api.auth import get_current_user as _auth_get_current_user, require_admin as _auth_requ/

ctags.name: require_admin
ctags.pattern: /^def require_admin(user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user)) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/
